product.description: Classic picture light with patented shutters, finish #100 Antique Bronze
product.codeBasis: the maker's model number for the Antique Bronze finish
product.makerClaim: Museum certified as meeting the CIBSE museum lighting guide, with zero heat and UV output onto the canvas (the maker's statement)

light.beamName: LED lamps behind individual shutters in the hood; the hood swivels for height

electrical.control: in-line dimmer, dimmer at the driver, or a lighting control system such as DALI
electrical.supply: invisible wire, thin wire or rechargeable battery

housing.dimensionBasis: hood 5 cm by 3.5 cm as published; length made to order from 1 inch to 12 feet and bracket 2 in by 3/4 in, converted from inches
housing.materials: hood of aluminium, other parts of brass

photometricFile.note: The maker publishes no photometric file.

sources.title: Hogarth Fine Art Picture Lights, home page (clients and certification)

unverified: Luminous flux, intensity distribution and power: Hogarth publishes none; the record cannot be lit until the maker's photometry is obtained.
The CIBSE certification is the maker's claim; the certificate itself was not seen.
